result.summary: Independently re-verified REQ-033 end to end; PASS, routing to DOC-UPDATER. Lint and build re-run myself in apps/bot (not trusted from TEST-RUNNER): `npm run lint` -> eslint . exit 0, no output; `npm run build` -> tsc -p tsconfig.json exit 0, no output. Live-DB spot-check done independently (own fresh postgres:16-alpine container req033-validate, own seed rows, own UUIDs -- not copied from the report): applied all 8 migrations 0000-0007 in order with zero ERROR lines, 0007's tag sequence matched spec exactly (CREATE TABLE/3x ALTER TABLE/CREATE INDEX/ALTER TABLE). Ran AC4 (bad invite_code_id insert into registrations fails with exact `registrations_invite_code_id_invite_codes_id_fk` FK violation; real-id insert succeeds) and AC5 (DELETE of a referenced invite_codes row fails with the exact RESTRICT error naming the same constraint; row confirmed still present after) -- both the highest-risk cases per the handoff's own suggestion, both reproduced exactly. All 9 acceptance criteria confirmed individually against actual shipped code, not TEST-RUNNER's summary: AC1 (apps/bot/drizzle/0007_sturdy_network.sql + apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts's inviteCodes table -- PK/timestamps/7 data columns/3 FKs all ON DELETE RESTRICT/unique index, all match), AC2 (unique index invite_codes_code_unique present in migration -- constraint-name match confirmed structurally, and via my own AC4/AC5 runs which exercised the same constraint family), AC3 (issuedToUserId/grantsCompanionOf both nullable FKs to users.id in schema.ts, matching design), AC4 (independently spot-checked live, see above), AC5 (independently spot-checked live, see above), AC6 (ran `npx vitest run src/domain/inviteCode.test.ts` myself -- 5/5 pass, including the runtime CSPRNG-source test; re-ran the static grep myself: `grep -n Math.random apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts` hits only the comment at line 25, `grep -n 'Math\.random\(' ...` (real call syntax) returns zero matches -- confirms zero actual Math.random usage, TEST-RUNNER's MINOR characterization is correct and non-blocking, no real gap masked), AC7 (vitest alphabet/length assertions pass; `grep '26 . 5 = 130' docs/agents/design/REQ-033.md` reproduced 4 matches incl. explicit arithmetic), AC8 (all 4 required greps against docs/agents/design/REQ-033.md reproduced: composition framing line 124, legal-combinations header line 132, 'configurable per event' lines 330/334/443/465, REQ-038 routing-not-resolution line 339), AC9 (`grep -inE` for the 5 forbidden column names against 0007_sturdy_network.sql -- zero matches, exit 1). requirements.yaml checked for staleness: REQ-033's description text on the alphabet ('excluding visually ambiguous characters, with a stated length giving the entropy S4 demands') is deliberately non-specific about which characters/length, so it is not contradicted by what shipped (32-symbol alphabet, L/Q included, 0/O/1/I excluded, 26 chars, 130 bits) -- no staleness found; owner (DATA-DESIGNER) and status (in_progress, correct pre-DOC-UPDATER) fields both still accurate. Diff scope confirmed complete via `git diff --stat master...HEAD`: schema.ts, 0007_sturdy_network.sql, migration snapshot/journal, inviteCode.ts, design doc and test spec all present, nothing missing or stray in repo root.

issues.summary: Confirmed (not newly filed -- already reported by TEST-RUNNER): REQ-033.md AC6's static grep pattern for Math.random matches a benign code comment in apps/bot/src/domain/inviteCode.ts (line 25) rather than only executable code. Independently re-verified this does not mask a real gap: `grep -n 'Math\.random\('` (actual call syntax) returns zero matches, and the runtime CSPRNG-source vitest test passes. Non-blocking; TEST-DESIGNER should tighten the grep pattern in a future pass.
